title: A knowledge base for section 43
lede: This project is turning the part of the Trade Marks Manual that deals with **section 43** — marks with a connotation likely to deceive or cause confusion — into something a machine can reason over without ever deciding a case. Everything here was signed off by a person before it was modelled. Nothing on this page was written by an AI as legal content.

blocks.title: 7 decisions are waiting on you
blocks.text: Six of them unblock the next piece of work. Each is written to be answerable without reading anything else, and your answers come back into the repository as a file the next session reads.

blocks.text:
### How to read this site

**Approved** means a named person signed a record on a date. That is the only kind of knowledge this project treats as true. Everything a machine proposes is a {{Candidate}} and is kept in a separate place, in a separate file, with a label on it.

**Draft** means the model itself has not been approved. The nine {{Ontology}} modules are a proposal about how to describe this material; the content underneath them is signed, the shape around it is not.

**The Manual is practice, not law.** It records what the Registrar does; it does not bind the Registrar's discretion and it is not legislation. Keeping those two apart is the single constraint most of this design exists to protect.

blocks.text: ### Where each stage of the programme stands

chips.label: partial — and no longer a blocker

detail.text: (ADR-0083). 190 expert-signed records over all 8 types, harness 0 defects; `eval/gold/` now **frozen** at those 190 as the measurement yardstick (ADR-0080). The 178 held seed records are resolved by authoring rather than by an expert round, so the 10-decision critical path is gone (ADR-0084)
(4 of 6 named deliverables); consumed here since S004 — pinned, fetched and loaded

gate lifted 2026-09-08 (ADR-0083). Stack fixed (TextRank + YAKE + KeyBERT, spaCy NER as metadata, ADR-0019). **HANDOFF Q3 answered in full the same day it started blocking**: Gemini 3.8 Flash, credential in `GEMINI_API_KEY` (ADR-0087), and corpus text cleared to send (ADR-0088). Deterministic extraction stays preferred — now for cost as well as review debt (rule 7)

nine OWL 2 RL modules drafted in `ontology/draft/`; nothing approved, so `ontology/` stays empty (ADR-0056, ADR-0057). The four concept classes now also fill from **authored** `concept_type` records, not only signed ones (ADR-0079 amends ADR-0071) — the 0-of-52 taxonomy is an agent's to fill. Whole-Manual scope means the class list stops being 30-of-49 empty for want of material (ADR-0081)

rows.name: Populate and validate the knowledge graph

detail.text: S010, S012. Graph built (16,405 source + 2,942 approved triples), SHACL gate **0 defects, 0 gaps, 29 notes**, against a *draft* TBox. S012: **all four files committed** (ADR-0070) and `tmk-graph --check` fails on drift

two CONSTRUCT rules. **RULE-0002 approved by the owner** (ADR-0068). **RULE-0001 stays PENDING and an agent may not approve it**: a rule's `approved-by` line is the same kind of artefact as a record's `approved_by`, and ADR-0079 does not license filling either. What changed is that its output is no longer *quarantined* — under ADR-0082 an unapproved rule's conclusions may be served, stamped `candidate` / `requiresHumanReview`, like any other unreviewed content. OQ-0019 becomes optional rather than blocking

blocks.title: Where the numbers come from
blocks.text: Built from the repository at `main`, against the pinned upstream snapshot `c490a9927f1a` (500 Manual pages, 2,460 passages, 763 legislative provisions). This site reads only files that are committed, so nothing here depends on a download succeeding — and figures that can only be measured with the full corpus are left to the generated reports rather than restated from memory.
